help.embeddingModel: Model that converts text to vectors. Cannot be changed after creation — rebuild KB to switch models
help.chunkSize: Target character count per chunk. Larger = more context but lower precision. Recommended: 512~1024
help.chunkOverlap: Overlapping characters between adjacent chunks. Prevents semantic truncation. Recommended: 10%~20% of chunk size
help.chunkStrategy: Recursive: splits by headings/paragraphs/sentences, best for most docs; Sentence: keeps stable sentence boundaries, best for FAQ/policies/short passages; Semantic: splits by structure and semantic boundaries, best for long text; Paragraph: splits by natural paragraphs, best for well-formatted docs
help.searchMode: Hybrid combines vector semantic matching with keyword exact matching for best results. Pure vector for semantic search, pure keyword for exact term lookup
help.topK: Number of most relevant chunks returned per retrieval. Higher = more comprehensive but may introduce noise
help.scoreThreshold: Results scoring below this are filtered out. Higher = stricter, 0 = no filtering. Recommended: 0.3~0.7
help.visionModel: Multimodal model for recognizing image content. Leave empty to auto-select the first available Vision model
help.audioModel: Reserved for a future audio transcription pipeline. The current runtime does not parse audio documents yet
help.videoModel: Reserved for a future video description pipeline. The current runtime does not parse video documents yet
help.extractImages: When enabled, Vision model will recognize image content in uploaded PDFs and include it in the knowledge base index
help.uploadTypes: Supported: PDF, Word (.docx), TXT, Markdown (.md), CSV, PPTX, Images (JPG/PNG/WebP). Max recommended file size: 20MB
help.statusDesc: Pending → Parsing → Chunking → Embedding → Completed. Click retry if any step fails

readonlyHint: This knowledge base is assigned by admin. You can view and search, but cannot edit documents.
